examples: tmux was killed and every pane vanished: recreate the sessions instead of starting new conversations.
how_to: Open the ended session's row menu and choose restart, or accept it in the reopen offer.
A new terminal starts under the same name and resumes the stored conversation.
name: Recreate a lost session
summary: bring a session back to life when its terminal process is gone but its conversation history is not.
where: A session whose terminal process is gone but whose conversation is kept shows in the running list as ended; its menu offers to bring it back.
After a reboot, the reopen offer does it for every lost session at once.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
